title: Hadamard regularization of open quantum systems coupled to unstructured environments in the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism
summary: The theory of open quantum systems addresses how coupling to external degrees of freedom modifies observables and quantum coherence, a situation central to fundamental condensed-matter research and emerging quantum technologies. Schwinger-Keldysh field theory is a natural framework for both open- and nonequilibrium quantum systems in terms of functional integrals. However, its numerical solution is limited by a cubic scaling with the number of time steps.
